summary: Page Style exchanges native fill items for the active page descriptor and paints them through the physical page format.
findings: Named page geometry and fill are committed together and survive Writer history, Worker serialization, and ODT export and import.
Chromium verified file import, stretched placement, transparency, undo, redo and reopening. The renderer test proves tiled offsets use image dimensions.
residual_risks: Gradient, pattern, and hatch fill editing, the desktop bitmap preset management, editable bitmap size, and staggered tiling remain outside the represented UI. Existing Calc JSDoc and size diagnostics remain.
